summary.text: Descendant of Anthas who led colonists from Troezen and founded Halicarnassus and Myndus in Caria.

story.text: Pausanias records that many years after Troezen was named for Troezen brother of Pityus, the descendants of Aetius son of Anthas were dispatched as colonists from Troezen and founded Halicarnassus and Myndus in Caria.
